**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Publish a descriptor manifest for the incident audit**

When this quarantined audit is published, these lines copy the four descriptor sets but never generate the required `DESCRIPTORS.json` and `locator_map`. The committed audit evidence refers to `shared/job-descriptors/...`, which does not exist in the checkout, so readers cannot reliably resolve those locators to `incident-descriptors/` or verify the role/release/hash bindings; `docs/ROLE-COMPLIANCE.md` lines 151–158 requires this manifest for every audited round. Generate and publish the descriptor manifest alongside these copies.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Handle the absent review-followup manifest**

In a fresh checkout of this commit, `runs/GPT-COMPLIANCE-0004/public-review-followups.json` does not exist, and a repo-wide search finds no batch-0004 producer for it. Because `receipt()` reads it unconditionally for every one of the eight published PRs, the new publication audit raises `FileNotFoundError` before cloning and checking public bytes, even when there are simply no retained followups. Treat the missing file as an empty followup list, as the script already does for optional audit corrections, or publish the required manifest with this audit.

comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Do not register protocol auditors as scientific verifiers**

When a future EDA-0011 dossier is promoted or jointly abandoned, it can name this protocol-audit session as its verifier because `scripts/project.py` only checks the registry entry's `role` and `topic` (lines 125-127 and 209-211), ignoring `session_kind`. Consequently, validation can pass without the mandatory scientific verifier even though this entry explicitly says it is “not scientific acceptance”; register auditors under a distinct role or make the validator reject protocol-audit sessions for scientific decisions.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L13-L13](https://github.com/getm0ss1moving/EDA-Topic-selection-and-Experiment/blob/4a76cec8fcfd808c7c9a12a34fa46349da382f00/AGENTS.md#L13-L13)

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Replace the invalid OpenROAD line ranges**

Anyone reopening C3-CLM-001 at this pinned URL cannot follow the recorded locator: [the referenced `TritonRoute.cpp`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/The-OpenROAD-Project/OpenROAD/b16bda7e82721d10566ff7e2b68f1ff0be9f9e38/src/drt/src/TritonRoute.cpp) has only 1,388 lines, so the range ending at 1,450 and the challenge's claimed 1,447–1,448 file-open check do not exist; the relevant `getDRCMarkers` and `reportDRC` code is instead around lines 980–1064 and 1295–1385. Because the verifier repeats these offsets, correct the source locator and every downstream citation, or pin the revision whose bytes actually match the reported ranges.

info.body:
Protocol auditors could previously be cited as scientific verifiers by a future canonical dossier because registry role/topic checks ignored their audit purpose. Acceptance and joint-abandonment validation now reject typed protocol-purpose registrations, legacy protocol/governance markers, protocol actor identities and protocol-purpose verdicts. Legacy scientific registrations remain valid; new auditors receive an explicit purpose field. This addresses the governance finding on PR #78.

A separate still-unadjudicated public source-locator allegation from PR #79 is recorded for the final D04 scientific verifier only. Its assigned metadata file will be hash-bound before execution and exported with its public descriptors. No source allegation is accepted or dismissed by this transport PR, and no proposer/challenger is assigned that note.

Validation: all 139 tests pass, including valid-science controls, auditor-attribution rejection for acceptance/abandonment, wrong-topic rejection and exact/tampered metadata transport; project validation and diff checks pass. Frozen research outputs and historical registrations are not rewritten.

comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require assigned public evidence to exist before export**

When a verifier's `JOB.json` contains `public_evidence` but `public-evidence.json` is deleted or otherwise missing before publication, this existence guard skips all validation and silently publishes descriptors without the evidence that influenced the verifier. The resulting round retains the claimed hash in `JOB.json` but cannot reproduce or inspect the assigned allegation; check the assignment metadata as well as file presence and fail closed when either side is missing.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L15-L15](https://github.com/getm0ss1moving/EDA-Topic-selection-and-Experiment/blob/6544a22add519911c0ca7cf1392946f5e8843137/AGENTS.md#L15-L15)

The existing positive export control and all 139 regression tests pass. No frozen science or role packets changed.

Addresses PR #80 review PRRT_kwDOVElOAM6tFZ1P. All 139 regression tests, structural validation and diff checks pass. No frozen scientific output, role packet or verdict is changed.
